↗Transaction LabIndependent transaction previews Read-only workspace

HYPEREVM · CHAIN 999

Inspect before you transact.

Simulate an unsigned call or inspect a historical execution. See the evidence behind each result.

Research preview
01

Transaction

No wallet needed

Loading examples…

The public account whose transaction is being evaluated.

Enter deployment bytecode, including constructor arguments. The deployment address is calculated from the sender's nonce at the selected block. Nothing is sent to the network.

Native token amount as an integer number of wei.

Use latest or a hexadecimal block number. The result records the state used.

Provider simulation · incomplete asset coverage · network fees excluded. This does not verify destination credit.

Advanced: gas limit

Leave blank for 2,000,000 gas, or enter 21,000 to 5,000,000 without commas. This limits the original call. Provider measurement calls use separate limits.

Using the default limit: 2,000,000 gas.

Advanced: gas limit

Leave blank for the default. Enter 21,000 to 5,000,000 gas without commas. This limits the original call; a lower limit can cause it to fail. Each token or position query keeps a separate 1,000,000 gas limit; ETH balance reads use no query gas.

Using the default limit: 5,000,000 gas.

Advanced: transaction fees

Optional. Use the selected block’s base fee and your fee caps for the original execution. Measurement queries stay unpriced. Declared blob hashes also require a blob fee cap; blob charges are burned separately.

Required with blob versioned hashes in optional context. Leave blank for calls without blobs. Blob sidecars, whole-blob validity and inclusion are not checked. Local point-evaluation calls (0x0a) check single-point KZG proofs on Cancun or later.

Enter fee amounts in whole wei without commas. The priority fee cannot exceed the maximum fee. A fee cap below the selected base fee cannot execute.

Advanced: transaction context

Automatically check up to eight observed ETH accounts and eight token balance or allowance queries. Other changes may be missed.

Advanced: balance & position checks

Automatic token checks use observed events and calls. Choose a manual list for specific token or position checks instead. ETH account selection remains automatic.

Add one to eight queries combined, using the formats below. Position checks are explicit only and are not selected automatically.

Examples preload their recorded query list. It is only used when manual checks are enabled. Editing the transaction does not automatically change this list.

Local ETH check: add an explicit account to the same list, with up to eight queries combined.

{"kind":"native_balance","account":"<account address>"}

Only listed accounts are checked. ETH changes include fees when transaction fees are enabled; otherwise fees are excluded. No automatic account discovery or complete effect coverage.

Each call starts from the simulated state left by the previous call, using the same wallet and block context. A later failure does not undo an earlier simulated call. Network fees and outer signatures are not modeled.

◈ No signing, broadcasting, or asset movement.
